final.primary_estimand: Within-subject change in whole-blood expression after cardiopulmonary exercise (2 maximal CPET ~24 h apart; day 1 baseline vs days 2, 3, 7) in ME/CFS and in sedentary controls, and whether that change differs between the groups.
planned_contrasts: Day 1 vs Day 2 / Day 3 / Day 7 within CFS and within HC (TAB3 lower block; paper 0 each)
Pre vs post in ME/CFS as compared to controls, overall (days 1,2 vs days 3,7) or at any single time point (S3.3.p2; paper 0)
ME/CFS vs controls at day 1, 2, 3, 7 (TAB3; paper 0,0,0,1) and all days (TAB3; paper 6; associational, not an exercise effect)
Low VO2 ME/CFS subset and test-retest subset vs regular repeat exercise by day (TAB3; subject labels not deposited)
final.design_timing: Blood drawn within 2 h BEFORE each CPET on day 1 and day 2, then at home on day 3 and day 7 (S2.5.p1). Day 1 is the only unexercised sample; there is no acute post-exercise sample.
final.inclusion: 14 female ME/CFS, 11 matched sedentary controls (S3.1.p1); day 3 and day 7 samples of one subject removed for <40% expressed genes (S3.3.p1); subjects who completed only one CPET retained (S3.2.p2)

paper_threshold.literal_text: fold change > +/-1.5, p-value < 0.05, and adjusted p-value (or FDR) < 0.1% (S2.5.1.p1)
paper_threshold.interpretation: Methods print 'FDR < 0.1%' but every all-days DEG in TAB4 has FDR 0.02-0.10; the rule that generated the reported lists is FDR < 0.1 (10%). The literal 0.001 rule is carried as the audit rule.

final.paper_method: Partek Flow 5.0 multimodel (normal, lognormal, lognormal with shrinkage, negative binomial, Poisson; per-gene best AICc) on STAR/Cufflinks hg38 RefSeq FPKM (S2.5.1.p1)
final.paper_results: 0 DEGs before vs after exercise in either group; 6 ME/CFS vs control all days, 1 at day 7; 19 unique overall, 15 considered likely false positives (S3.3.p2, S4.p2)

reasoning: Study map from S2.2, S2.4, S2.5, S2.5.1, S3.3 and TAB3/TAB4.
